title: Create landing page with direct join/authentication access

requirements.text: Create a dedicated landing page (route '/') that serves as the public entry point to RevReel. The page should prominently feature a 'Join RevReel' call-to-action button that triggers Internet Identity login. Upon successful authentication, the user is redirected to the main app feed ('/feed'). If the user is already authenticated, automatically redirect them to '/feed' without showing the landing page.

quotes: Make a landing page that you can just join from there to access the app

acceptanceCriteria: A landing page is rendered at the root route '/' for unauthenticated users
The page displays a prominent 'Join RevReel' button that initiates Internet Identity login
After successful login, the user is automatically redirected to '/feed'
Authenticated users visiting '/' are immediately redirected to '/feed'
The landing page is fully accessible without authentication (no AuthGuard wrapping it)
The landing page visually reflects the RevReel brand (dark theme, neon accents, car culture aesthetic consistent with the rest of the app)

requirements.text: Update the TanStack Router route configuration in App.tsx to register the new landing page as the root route '/' and move or adjust the existing default route so the feed is accessible at '/feed'. Ensure the Layout shell is only applied to authenticated app routes, not the landing page.

quotes: Make a landing page that you can just join from there to access the app

acceptanceCriteria: The root route '/' renders the new LandingPage component without the Layout shell
All existing app routes (feed, profile, upload, discover, meets, mechanics, inbox, admin, notifications, builds, classifieds) remain accessible and functional
Navigation between landing page and app routes works correctly

requirements.text: Design the landing page with a visually striking hero section that includes the RevReel logo/wordmark, a bold tagline describing the car culture video platform, and the 'Join RevReel' authentication button. Use the existing dark theme with neon accent colors, glassmorphism, and car-culture aesthetic consistent with the rest of the app (Barlow font, OKLCH color tokens from index.css).

quotes: Make a landing page that you can just join from there to access the app

acceptanceCriteria: Landing page displays the RevReel brand name/logo prominently
A tagline or brief description of the platform is shown
The 'Join RevReel' button is visually prominent and clearly actionable
Page uses the dark theme, neon effects, and Barlow font consistent with the rest of the app
Page is responsive and looks good on mobile and desktop

constraints: Do not modify files in frontend/src/hooks/ (immutable paths)
Do not modify frontend/src/main.tsx or frontend/src/components/ui/
Use Internet Identity (via useInternetIdentity hook) for authentication — no other auth provider
Preserve all existing routes and their functionality
nonGoals: Adding onboarding steps or multi-step sign-up flows after authentication
Collecting user data (email, username) on the landing page before authentication
Adding marketing or pricing sections to the landing page
Changing backend logic or data models

required: Dark cinematic car culture hero background with motion blur street racing lights and asphalt texture (landing-hero.dim_1920x1080.png)
